recent_learnings.lesson: New channel provider labels must update SeatProvider and all exhaustive provider maps, not only dispatcher SQL/string checks.
When replacing authority functions, diff inherited side effects explicitly; new linkage must not erase existing outcome/event recording.
Blob-independent erasure must distinguish workspace row existence from candidate-in-blob presence; malformed state still raises, absence records zero.
When adding erasure receipt stores, widen the named check constraint and assert both allowed store and unknown-store rejection.
Job payload privacy contracts belong at enqueue authority; handler-only cleanup cannot protect future producers.
Loop workers should call machine routes for TS provider adapters; production copies .mjs scripts, not source TS modules.
Provider adapters import transport only; policy egress may mint clearance, but importing policy from adapters recreates Rock 2 cycles.
Human-gated loop stages stop at gates; wrap workspace patches and job follow-ons in one SQL transaction.
Separate source proof from sandbox socket blockers; Docker and TSX IPC failures are environment evidence, not DB behavior proof.
Archive and rewrite the MSourcing Relay Baton every shift; Claude continuation must never depend on chat context.
Audit actual LangChain payloads; disabled framework tools can still inject pinned built-ins that strict gateways must strip exactly.
Never call source enterprise-ready while live SHA, migrations, model credit, governance, deployment receipts, or acceptance evidence remain unproven.
Demo mode must block non-synthetic candidate data before I/O and again at commit, storage, and hydration boundaries.
Durable sourcing feedback must reload from server authority and merge by receipt; component-only prompts lose lessons and can cross campaign state.
Graphify adds runtime value only through aggregate digest-bound clustering and separate human promotion; it never invents needs, candidates, or queries.
Paid enrichment needs persisted candidate authority, retry-convergent state, bounded retention, and release evidence bound to exact worker, image, and deployment.
Unknown candidate facts must remain nullable through mapping, scoring, consent, and outreach; personalized claims require shared role evidence and canonical persisted authority.
Campaign mutations need synchronous commit results, authoritative role gates, exact runtime projection, non-reflective tests, and aggregate success only when every requested role completes.
Store refactors need hook behavior, exact action parity, and static/runtime cycle gates; negative assertions must never reflect full workspace state.
Keep live candidate normalization in a neutral sourcing module; mock modules may expose compatibility re-exports but cannot own live behavior.
Retry-safety classification needs one neutral owner across provider adapters; HTTP 408 and server failures remain ambiguous.
Derive documentation facts from package, migration, and config sources; label current operations separately from historical audit evidence.
Never interpolate credentials into shell argv; use client-native auth and inspect process commands only after excluding authorization arguments.
For pure store splits, extract React-free helpers only; leave provider-bound hooks/contracts when cycle risk exceeds comprehension gain.
Supersede old evidence packs with dated status plus banners; keep one annotated migration list to avoid stale deploy contradictions.
Move shared floor contracts into lib before deleting 3D branches; component-owned pure helpers create lib-to-component inversions.
Live fleet seats must persist before UI adoption; local seat_* IDs break OAuth, send, domain, and calendar UUID gates.
Query-auth MCP secrets need closed param enums, base-url save rejection, host-only errors, and centralized redaction before URL assembly.
Exec dashboards need a pure shared derivation over canonical metrics so page UI and tests cannot fork live KPI filters.
Databricks intake must check public host before secrets or fetches; SQL time filters stay bound parameters, never interpolated.
Win derivation must join outreachHistory messageIds to outreach, then apply real-send predicate; candidate history alone can count dry-runs.
Real contact KPIs need dryRun:false plus sentAt; ledger sent and approval state are not enough.
Possessive compensation nouns like our range/band/budget must be topic-gated; safe target questions stay explicit allowlist exceptions.
Candidate compensation safety needs allowlisted reply moves; denylist euphemisms and salary numbers are only secondary backup checks.
Compliant LinkedIn discovery must scope web_search server-side; UI-built queries alone do not prove site:linkedin.com/in enforcement.
Plain tsx route tests cannot use node:test module mocks; use existing local admin harness or run with Node mock flags.
Candidate-facing model prompts need whitelist source minimization plus sink scans; injection regex is only triage, not the boundary.
Stored spendable keys need permission-gated resolution and null-on-decrypt-failure fallback tests.
Integration placeholders need seed and persisted-state migrations; fixing defaults alone leaves fabricated connected statuses in existing workspaces.
